name: sidecar-wake-dev-rec
description: Wake co-op with no bots and the server recorder preloaded, for lab/dev_index_probe.mjs and lab/dev_index_page_probe.cjs: one sidecar soldier fires the BAR prone and the recorder logs each round's launch frame and flight, so its deviation draw can be fitted to an input index (ledger DEV-14). Point `preload` at a copy built with -DREC_FIRE_INDEX=1 for the server's own index (`gi`) and the full-precision frame (features/server-replay-recorder/README.md); the shipped recorder.so writes neither. No bots, so every round in the file is the probe's.
human: No client: `node lab/dev_index_probe.mjs 127.0.0.1:14568 probe.ndjson`, then `lab.py stop` and `lab/dev_index_check.py`.
